verdict.line: You lose the fight when Jax lands Counter Strike's stun and chains it into an Empower auto during a long skirmish; you win it when you parry his key auto with Riposte or force a short, isolated trade off a double Lunge.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by trade length, not raw damage: Jax wants extended skirmishes where his Relentless Assault attack-speed ramp and Empower autos pile up, while Fiora wants short, auto-heavy exchanges where Riposte can parry his one key basic attack. Neither side has a structural cooldown or damage edge — Fiora's 50.8% overall top lane win rate and the 47.6% mark across 189 head-to-head games both sit close to even. The difference comes down to who baits the other's cooldown first.

theirWindow.when: Right after he lands Counter Strike's stun
theirWindow.what: He follows the stun with an Empower-boosted auto and can chain into Relentless Assault's attack-speed ramp for a full trade. Back off or hold Riposte rather than staying in melee range.

yourWindow.when: When his E (Counter Strike) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Engage with Q (Lunge) knowing he has no stun to punish your dash-in, and hold W (Riposte) ready to parry the auto he needs to land Empower's bonus damage.

start.why: Run in 50.5% of wins over 210 games (88.2% pick) — the lifesteal keeps you healthy while Duelist stacks, which matters since you want to win short auto trades rather than avoid them entirely.

boots.why: Taken in 70.7% of games at 48.4% win rate — flat physical damage reduction blunts both Empower autos and Relentless Assault's third-hit bonus damage, the two things doing most of Jax's trade damage.

core.why: First item on the 66.7%-win, 43.2%-pick path — the heal-on-hit stacks with Duelist to keep you topped up through repeated Lunges.
Second item on the same path — the move speed proc extends what Burst of Speed already gives you, letting you stick to Jax after he Leap Strikes away.
Closes out the 66.7%-win path — the damage-over-time conversion lets you survive the burst window right after he lands a Counter Strike stun instead of dying to it outright.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks over the course of an extended trade and heals you back, which directly counters the fact that Jax wants those same extended trades for his own attack-speed ramp — you outlast what he's trying to out-skirmish you with.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the standard pick (84.7% pick rate) and secures the early skirmish kills that swing an even lane; Flash + Teleport runs a slightly higher win rate (52.4%) and lets you exploit Fiora's split-push and pick threat once your core items are online.

playing.title: Bait Leap Strike before trading
playing.detail: Q (Leap Strike, 17/14/11/8/5s cd) is Jax's only gap closer. Once he burns it to engage or reposition, punish immediately with your own Q (Lunge) since he has no way to close the gap back on you.

playing.title: Hold Riposte for a real auto
playing.detail: Jax leans on basic attacks through Empower and Relentless Assault, so save W (Riposte, 10/9/8/7/6s cd) to parry an actual auto-attack trade rather than popping it early just for the AD buff.

playing.title: Never Lunge into an active Counter Strike
playing.detail: His E (Counter Strike, 18/16/14/12/10s cd) dodges your basic attacks for its duration, then stuns and damages anyone nearby when it ends. Wait out the stance before committing your combo.

playing.title: Double-Lunge to reset distance
playing.detail: Q can be recast a second time within a couple seconds at no mana cost. Use the second cast to disengage if he punishes your first dash-in instead of forcing a bad follow-up trade.

playing.title: Stack Duelist before you commit
playing.detail: Land a few autos or Lunges first to build Fiora's passive healing stacks so you're already topped up before trading into an Empower-boosted auto.

playing.title: Use Burst of Speed to deny his reset
playing.detail: E's attack speed window plus the move speed gained per landed hit lets you stick to him after a Leap Strike disengage, denying him the reset he needs to re-enter safely.

playing.title: Save Blade Waltz for skirmishes, not lane
playing.detail: R (130-110s cd) hits multiple enemy champions with damage falloff on repeat hits to the same target — it's a teamfight or pick tool, not a cooldown to spend on a single 1v1 duel.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, and every win-rate or pick-rate figure above are measured from real OP.GG games on the current patch, including the 189-game Fiora-vs-Jax sample. The cooldown windows, ability tells, and trade-timing reasoning built around that data are our own tactical read, not sourced numbers.

stats.opponentTip: Use [W] to hit him as Jax will rely on basic attacks to deal most of his damage. Hit [P] through your [Q] to contest lane.
